SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) as total_consumption
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
LIMIT 5

FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.CustomerID IS NULL
LIMIT 10

       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.CustomerID IS NOT NULL THEN c.CustomerID END) as with_consumption,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.CustomerID IS NULL THEN c.CustomerID END) as without_consumption
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
